sloka: ततस्तु लङ्का सहसा प्रदग्धा सराक्षसा साश्वरथा सनागा ।सपक्षिसङ्घा समृगा सवृक्षा रुरोद दीना तुमुलं सशब्दम् ।। 5.54.40 ।।।।
transliteration: tatastu laṅkā sahasā pradagdhā sarākṣasā sāśvarathā sanāgā ।sapakṣisaṅghā samṛgā savṛkṣā ruroda dīnā tumulaṁ saśabdam ।। 5.54.40 ।।।।

translations.english: "O father dear O son O my dear O friend alas, the life which is enjoyable, sacred and prosperous is destroyed in this way". Saying this, the demons cried out dreadfully and loudly.
